candidates.name: Commercial Installation Corporation
candidates.partition_evidence: Home page lists toilet partitions and toilet accessories among its services, next to doors, frames, hardware, operable walls and overhead doors. No project list or photos on the site.
red_flags: No project photos or project list
Only emails shown are named staff addresses (president, project manager); no generic company email
Supply-and-install arrangement for partitions not stated
candidates.reason: A Lewiston commercial installation company whose own site lists toilet partitions and accessories as services. It sits inside the area, so it is a strong candidate, though the site shows no partition projects.

license.name: Commercial Installation Corporation
license.registry: None applies: Maine has no state general or specialty contractor license (Maine Attorney General, Home Construction and Repair page); no Portland, ME city contractor registration recorded for this area
license.note: Maine does not license general contractors or partition installers at the state level. The Maine AG page says: 'In Maine, general contractors - and trades such as roofing and framing - are not licensed or regulated.' That reading comes from research/state-licensing/states.json (law_verified true, checked 2026-11-19). The Maine PFR professions page returned 403 when fetched on 2026-11-20. The area's local rule is 'none', so there was no registry to search. The company website (http://www.cic2010.net/, read 2026-11-20) says the company is based in Lewiston, ME, was established in 1979, and serves Maine and New England. It lists toilet partitions and accessories, doors, frames, hardware, operable walls and specialty products. The site shows no license numbers. Company phone: (207) 784-7943. No Maine Secretary of State entity search was run.

Maine is not named; it says only New England and the northeast
candidates.reason: A regional Division 10 supplier and installer in Raymond, NH (about 70 miles away) that says it serves New England and shows partition installation work. It also sells partitions itself.

license.name: Granite State Specialties

Based in Westborough, MA (AGC listing), about 120 to 150 miles from Portland, at the edge of the regional limit
newtonbsi.com showed only a page title, and its /contact page returned a 404
candidates.reason: It says it bids and installs Division 10 work in Maine, but its own site couldn't be read and no partition installs were shown. It is also part of a partition seller, which makes it a direct competitor and a buy-around risk.

license.name: Newton Building Specialties & Installation (Newton BSI)
license.registry: None applies: Maine has no statewide general or specialty contractor license (Maine Attorney General, Home Construction and Repair page); no Portland, ME city rule is on file in research/local-rules/cities.json and none was given for this area
license.note: Checked 2026-11-20. Maine licenses trades such as plumbers and electricians but not partition installers, per research/state-licensing/states.json (law_url read 2026-11-19). The project has no local rule for Portland, ME, so Portland building and code enforcement remains unconfirmed. The business is based in Westborough, MA. Massachusetts home improvement contractor registration covers only owner-occupied homes of 1 to 4 units, and its construction supervisor license applies only to Massachusetts permits, so neither applies to work in Maine. The company homepage (newtonbsi.com) showed only its title, with no license number or service area. No license number was recorded.

The source_url is a Blue Book directory listing, not an official registry, and it was seen only as a web search summary, not opened directly. The summary gives Door Systems Corp. in Lewiston, ME with 5-9 employees, serving Maine and Vermont. Its lines include overhead and rolling steel doors and toilet and cubicle partitions. No company website was found, and no phone or license number was read. No Maine Secretary of State entity search was run.
